title: Tichu
invalidCombo: Invalid combination (cannot be played as is)

tutorial.intro: Tichu is a 2-vs-2 partnership game. Players sitting across from each other (P0 & P2, P1 & P3) are teammates. The goal is to empty your hand first.
tutorial.declare: Before play you may call 'Tichu' (±100) or 'Grand Tichu' (±200). Go out first to earn the bonus, fail and you lose it.
tutorial.play: Play combinations (single, pair, straight, bomb, ...) like Daifugo to control the table. The four special cards — Dragon, Phoenix, Dog, Mahjong — are the key to the game.
tutorial.teams: 5s, 10s and Kings, plus the Dragon (+25) and Phoenix (-25), are the card points. Teams score by card points and finishing order; first to 1000 wins.

landscapeBanner: Rotate to landscape for easier play
